method: ffprobe for container facts; ffmpeg -f s16le -acodec pcm_s16le decode; lane-a/raw/asset_envelope.py: mono = mean(L,R), 0.5 s windows, RMS dBFS and share of power below 150 Hz (Hann-windowed FFT); boundary score = (mean dB of next 4 s − mean dB of previous 4 s) + 10 × (same difference of low-band share); strongest boundaries in 56–155 s listed in lane-a/raw/asset_envelope_loreen.txt. Window chosen to sit inside the emulator excerpt and to contain the strongest boundary with ≥ 38 s of lead-in and 18 s of tail.
